front: What is the dividing line between energy and protein concentrates?
back: About 20% crude protein: protein concentrates contain more than this.
Straight: one ingredient (maize meal). Compound: a balanced mixture for one class of animal (broiler starter, dairy meal).

front: When should grass be cut for hay?
back: At about early flowering, in dry weather.

front: Why is cottonseed cake fed mainly to ruminants?
back: It contains gossypol, harmful to pigs and poultry in large amounts.
